```bash json
  "email": "ilia@sfs.com",
  "fullname": "Ilia Bovk",
  "contractName": "Sales Contract",
  "recipientKey": "b113a5ea-115b-465c-a10f-baa361378e10"
}
```

#### "contract.approved"

```bash json
{
  "clientKey": "658599d9-bbbe-44ea-984e-0e5a766c2272",
  "contractKey": "433e835c-0630-418c-8cd6-af223bb079d5",
  "createTime": "2024-12-13T16:05:06.000Z",
  "status": "contract.approved",
  "email": "ilia@sfs.com",
  "fullname": "Ilia Bovk",
  "contractName": "Sales Contract",
  "recipientKey": "b113a5ea-115b-465c-a10f-baa361378e10"
}
```

#### "contract.signed"

```bash json
{
  "clientKey": "658599d9-bbbe-44ea-984e-0e5a766c2272",
  "contractKey": "433e835c-0630-418c-8cd6-af223bb079d5",
  "createTime": "2024-12-13T16:06:56.000Z",
  "status": "contract.signed",
  "email": "ilia@sendforsign.com",
  "fullname": "Ilia Bovk",
  "contractName": "Sales Contract",
  "recipientKey": "b113a5ea-115b-465c-a10f-baa361378e10"
}
```

#### "contract.fully_signed"

```bash json
{
  "clientKey": "658599d9-bbbe-44ea-984e-0e5a766c2272",
  "contractKey": "433e835c-0630-418c-8cd6-af223bb079d5",
  "createTime": "2024-12-13T16:06:56.000Z",
  "status": "contract.fully_signed",
  "contractName": "Sales Contract"
}
```

# Part 3. REST API reference

All resource endpoints take `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/<resource>` with body `{"data": {"action": "...", "clientKey": "...", ...}}` and header `X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY` unless stated otherwise.

## Client

### Create client

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/client/create

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/client`

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `client` (body, object, required): Structure, at least one of the fields must be filled.
  - `fullname` (body, string): First and second names of the client.
  - `email` (body, string): Email of the client.
  - `organization` (body, string): Organization name.
  - `customKey` (body, string): Your custom key, if you don't need to use any of the above fields.
  - `users` (body, string): Array of users, optional.
    - `fullname` (body, string): First and second names of the user.
    - `email` (body, string): Email of the user.
    - `customKey` (body, string): A custom user key, if you don't need to use any of the above fields.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/client' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{ 
		  "data": {
				   "action": "create",
				   "client": {
							  "fullname": "John Johnson",
							  "email": "john_johnson@mail.com",
							  "organization": "Company Inc.",
							  "customKey": "YOUR_COMBINATION",
							  "users": [{
								"fullname": "John Johnson",
							    "email": "john_johnson@mail.com", 
							    "customKey": "YOUR_COMBINATION"
							  }]
						     }
				  }
       }'
```

Response:
```json
{
       "client": {
                "createTime": "2023-12-01 12:18:55",
                "clientKey": "CLIENT_KEY",
				"users": [{
					"createTime": "2023-12-01 12:18:55",
					"default": true,
					"userKey": "USER_KEY"
				}]
                 },
       "code": "201",
       "message": "Client created"
    }
```

### Update client

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/client/update

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/client`

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `client` (body, object, required): Structure, use the fields that should be updated.
  - `clientKey` (body, string, required): ID of the client.
  - `fullname` (body, string): First and second names of the client.
  - `email` (body, string): Email of the client.
  - `organization` (body, string): Organization name.
  - `customKey` (body, string): Client custom key, if you used it when creating the client.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/client' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{ 
		  "data": {
				   "action": "update",
				   "client": {
							  "clientKey": "CLIENT_KEY",
							  "fullname": "John Johnson",
							  "email": "john_johnson@mail.com",
							  "organization": "Company Inc.",
							  "customKey": "YOUR_COMBINATION"
						     }
				  }
       }'
```

Response:
```json
{
       "client": {
                "changeTime": "2023-12-01 12:18:55",
                "clientKey": "CLIENT_KEY", 
		},
       "code": "201",
       "message": "Client updated"
    }
```

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/client`

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `client` (body, object, required): Structure, at least one of the fields must be filled.
  - `clientKey` (body, string): ID of the client.
  - `fullname` (body, string): First and second names of the client.
  - `email` (body, string): Email of the client.
  - `organization` (body, string): Organization name.
  - `customKey` (body, string): Client custom key, if you used it when creating the client.

Example:
```bash

     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
```

Response:

## Contract

### Create contract

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/contract/create

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/contract`

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `userKey` (body, string): ID of the user who create the contract. If not specified, the default user credentials will be used.
- `contract` (body, object, required): Contract structure.
  - `name` (body, string): Name of the contract.
  - `value` (body, string): Content of the contract, use HTML.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/contract' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{ 
		  "data": {
				   "action": "create",
				   "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
                   "userKey": "USER_KEY", 
				   "contract": {
							  "name": "New contract",
							  "value": "<p>Contract text</p>"
						     }
				  }
       }'
```

Response:
```json
{
       "contract": {
                "createTime": "2023-12-01 12:18:55",
                "contractKey": "CONTRACT_KEY"
                 },
       "code": "201",
       "message": "Contract created"
    }
```

### Create from template

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/contract/create-from-template

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/contract`

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `userKey` (body, string): ID of the user who create the contract. If not specified, the default user credentials will be used.
- `contract` (body, object, required): Contract structure.
  - `name` (body, string): Name of the contract.
  - `templateKey` (body, string): Template from which you are creating a contract.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/contract' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{ 
		  "data": {
				   "action": "create",
				   "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
                   "userKey": "USER_KEY", 
				   "contract": {
							  "name": "New contract",
							  "templateKey": "TEMPLATE_KEY"
						     }
				  }
       }'
```

Response:
```json
{
       "contract": {
                "createTime": "2023-12-01 12:18:55",
                "contractKey": "CONTRACT_KEY"
                 },
       "code": "201",
       "message": "Contract created"
    }
```

### Create and send contract

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/contract/create-send

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/contract`

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `userKey` (body, string): ID of the user who create the contract. If not specified, the default user credentials will be used.
- `contract` (body, object, required): Contract structure.
  - `name` (body, string): Name of the contract.
  - `value` (body, string): Content of the contract, use HTML.
- `recipients` (body, array): Array of recipients, optional.
  - `action` (body, string): What the recipient needs to do with the contract. Available options: `view`, `sign`, `approve`, and `lock`.
  - `customMessage` (body, string): Custom note to the recipient. If not specified, the default message will be sent.
  - `fullname` (body, string): Full name of the recipient.
  - `email` (body, string, required): Email of the recipient.
  - `position` (body, number): Signing order. If not specified, all requests will be sent simultaneously.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/contract' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{ 
		  "data": {
				   "action": "create",
				   "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
                   "userKey": "USER_KEY", 
				   "contract": {
							  "name": "New contract",
							  "value": "<p>Contract text</p>"
						     },
           "recipients":[{
                "action": "view",
                "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
                "customMessage": "Custom message text",
                "fullname": "John Johnson", 
                "email": "john_johnson@mail.com", 
                "position": 1
               }] 
				  }
       }'
```

Response:
```json
{
       "contract": {
                "createTime": "2023-12-01 12:18:55",
                "contractKey": "CONTRACT_KEY"
                 },
       "code": "201",
       "message": "Contract created"
    }
```

### Create and fill in contract

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/contract/create-fill

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/contract`

The best way to fill in contracts is to prepare a template that already contains all the necessary 
placeholders in the text. This way, you can populate the necessary data in the right placeholders within 
the contracts with a single API call.

  Matching placeholders by `name` here is not reliable. To be sure every value lands, create the contract, then
  [list its placeholders](https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/placeholder/list) and [update](https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/placeholder/update) each one by
  the contract's `placeholderKey`. A contract created from a template gets new placeholder keys; match them to the
  template's placeholders by name.

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `userKey` (body, string): ID of the user who create the contract. If not specified, the default user credentials will be used.
- `contract` (body, object, required): Contract structure.
  - `name` (body, string): Name of the contract.
  - `templateKey` (body, string): Template from which you are creating a contract.
- `placeholders` (body, array): Array of placeholders, optional.
  - `placeholderKey` (body, string): A placeholder key corresponds to a specific placeholder in the template from which you create a contract. Use this parameter if you need to populate any value into this specific placeholder.
  - `name` (body, string): Name of the placeholder.
  - `value` (body, string): Value of the placeholder.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/contract' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{
    "data": {
        "action": "create",
        "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
        "userKey": "USER_KEY",
        "contract": {
            "name": "New contract",
            "templateKey": "TEMPLATE_KEY"
        },
        "placeholders": [
            {
                "placeholderKey": "PLACEHOLDER_KEY",
                "value": "Placeholder value"
            },
            {
                "name": "Placeholder name",
                "value": "Placeholder value"
            }
        ]
    }
}'
```

Response:
```json
{
       "contract": {
                "createTime": "2023-12-01 12:18:55",
                "contractKey": "CONTRACT_KEY"
                 },
       "code": "201",
       "message": "Contract created"
    }
```

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/contract/update

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/contract`

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.

- `contract` (body, object, required): Structure, use the fields that should be updated.

  - `name` (body, string): Name of the contract.

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/contract' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{ 
		  "data": {
				   "action": "update",
				   "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
				   "contract": {
							  "contractKey": "CONTRACT_KEY", 
							  "name": "New contract",

				  }
       }'
```

Response:
```json
{
       "contract": {
                "createTime": "2023-12-01 12:18:55",

		},
```

### Duplicate contract

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/contract/duplicate

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/contract`

When duplicating a contract, the placeholder structure is copied, but all placeholder values are cleared.

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `contract` (body, object, required): Structure.
  - `contractKey` (body, string, required): Key of the contract that needs to be duplicated.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/contract' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{
    "data": {
        "action": "duplicate",
        "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
        "contract": {
            "contractKey": "YOUR_CONTRACT_KEY"
        }
    }
}'
```

Response:
```json
{
    "contract": {
        "createTime": "2023-12-01 12:18:55",
        "contractKey": "NEW_CONTRACT_KEY"
    },
    "code": "201",
    "message": "Contract duplicated"
}
```

### Archive contract

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/contract`

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `contract` (body, object, required): Structure.
  - `contractKey` (body, string): Key of the contract.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/contract' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{ 
		  "data": {
				   "action": "archive",
				   "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
				   "contract": {
							  "contractKey": "CONTRACT_KEY"
						     }
				  }
       }'
```

Response:
```json
{
       "contract": {
                "contractKey": "CONTRACT_KEY", 
				"name": "New contract"
		},
       "code": "200",
       "message": "Contract archived"
    }
```

### Get Timeline

## PDF and Word

### Download PDF

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/pdf/download

Endpoint: `GET https://api.sendforsign.com/api/download_pdf`

Retrieve a contract PDF. As a response, you will receive ArrayBuffer.

Parameters:
- `clientKey` (query, string, required): Key of the client.
- `contractKey` (query, string, required): Key of the contract.

Example:
```bash
curl -X GET 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/download_pdf?clientKey=658599d9-bbbe&contractKey=5cb-49c6-4f62-9b77-5c304' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
```

### Upload PDF

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/pdf/upload

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/upload_pdf`

Before uploading a PDF, you need to create an empty contract and obtain its Contract Key. 
To do this, use the [Create Contract](https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/contract/create) 
request with the parameter `"contractType": "pdf"`.

Here's an example:
```bash cURL
{
    "data": {
        "action": "create",
        "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
        "contract": {
            "name": "Your PDF name",
            "contractType": "pdf"
        }
    }
}
```

As a response, you'll receive a ContractKey for the contract you created. 
Use this key to upload your PDF to Sendforsign's infrastructure.

Additionally, you will need to include FormData in the body of the request. 

For example:

```bash cURL
-F 'pdf=@/path/to/yourfile.pdf;type=application/pdf'
```

Or in typescript:
```bash ts
formData.append('pdf', new Blob([pdfFile as BlobPart], {type: 'application/pdf'})) 
```

Where `pdfFile` is the ArrayBuffer of your document.

Parameters:
- `clientKey` (query, string, required): Key of the client.
- `contractKey` (query, string, required): Key of the contract.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/upload_pdf?clientKey=658599d9-bbbe&contractKey=5cb-49c6-4f62-9b77-5c304' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: multipart/form-data' \
     -F 'pdf=@/path/to/yourfile.pdf;type=application/pdf'
```

### Download Word

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/pdf/downloadword

Endpoint: `GET https://api.sendforsign.com/api/download_docx`

Retrieve a contract Word. As a response, you will receive ArrayBuffer.

Parameters:
- `clientKey` (query, string, required): Key of the client.
- `contractKey` (query, string, required): Key of the contract.

Example:
```bash
curl -X GET 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/download_docx?clientKey=658599d9-bbbe&contractKey=5cb-49c6-4f62-9b77-5c304' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
```

## Placeholder

### Create placeholder

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/placeholder/create

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/placeholder`

One way to add placeholders to a contract is when you create a new contract. 
[See this page](https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/contract/create-fill) to learn more.

If a contract already exists, use the request below.

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `contractKey` (body, string, required): Key of the contract.
- `placeholder` (body, object, required): Structure, add the fields that need to be updated and ignore the rest.
  - `name` (body, string, required): Name of the placeholder
  - `value` (body, string): Value of the placeholder.
  - `fillingType` (body, number): Who fills in this placeholder when the contract is shared ("Who fills in this field" in the editor): `1` — nobody (default), `2` — the contract owner, `3` — any recipient, `4` — a specific recipient set in `externalRecipientKey`. [See the use case.](https://sendforsign.com/docs/usecase/placeholder-filler)
  - `externalRecipientKey` (body, string): `recipientKey` of the recipient who fills in this placeholder. Required when `fillingType` is `4`. Get it from the [list of recipients](https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/recipient/list). Leave it out (or `null`) for any other `fillingType`.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/placeholder' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{
    "data": {
        "action": "create",
        "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
        "contractKey": "CONTRACT_KEY",
        "placeholder": {
            "name": "Placeholder name",
            "value": "Placeholder value",
            "fillingType": 4,
            "externalRecipientKey": "RECIPIENT_KEY"
        }
    }
}'
```

Response:
```json
{
    "placeholder": {
        "id": "3",
        "createTime": "2024-11-22T11:11:24.000Z",
        "changeTime": "2024-11-22T11:11:24.000Z",
        "name": "1",
        "value": "hello",
        "type": "1",
        "placeholderKey": "PLACEHOLDER_KEY",
        "position": "3"
    },
    "code": 201,
    "message": "Placeholder created"
}
```

### Update placeholder

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/placeholder/update

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/placeholder`

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `contractKey` (body, string, required): Key of the contract.
- `placeholder` (body, object, required): Structure, add the fields that need to be updated and ignore the rest.
  - `placeholderKey` (body, string, required): Key of the placeholder that needs to be updated.
  - `name` (body, string): Name of the placeholder
  - `value` (body, string): Value of the placeholder.
  - `fillingType` (body, number): Who fills in this placeholder when the contract is shared ("Who fills in this field" in the editor): `1` — nobody (default), `2` — the contract owner, `3` — any recipient, `4` — a specific recipient set in `externalRecipientKey`. [See the use case.](https://sendforsign.com/docs/usecase/placeholder-filler)
  - `externalRecipientKey` (body, string): `recipientKey` of the recipient who fills in this placeholder. Required when `fillingType` is `4`. Get it from the [list of recipients](https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/recipient/list). To unassign the recipient, send `"externalRecipientKey": null` explicitly together with the new `fillingType` (for example `1`, `2` or `3`): a field left out of an update keeps its current value, so omitting it does **not** clear it.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/placeholder' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{
    "data": {
        "action": "update",
        "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
        "contractKey": "CONTRACT_KEY",
        "placeholder": {
            "placeholderKey": "PLACEHOLDER_KEY",
            "name": "Name",
            "value": "Value",
            "fillingType": 4,
            "externalRecipientKey": "RECIPIENT_KEY"
        }
    }
}'
```

Response:
```json
{
    "placeholder": {
        "id": "1",
        "createTime": "2024-03-14T20:34:08.000Z",
        "changeTime": "2024-03-14T20:38:39.000Z",
        "name": "Name",
        "value": "Value",
        "type": "1",
        "placeholderKey": "PLACEHOLDER_KEY",
        "position": null
    },
    "code": "201",
    "message": "Placeholder updated"
}
```

### Table placeholder

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/placeholder/update-table

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/placeholder`

First, add a placeholder to the HTML document to obtain a placeholder key.
[See this page](https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/placeholder/create) to learn more.

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `contractKey` (body, string, required): Key of the contract.
- `placeholder` (body, object, required): Structure, add the fields that need to be updated and ignore the rest.
  - `placeholderKey` (body, string, required): Key of the placeholder that needs to be updated.
  - `table` (body, object, required): Table structure for the placeholder.
    - `columns` (body, array, required): Array of column headers (strings).
    - `rows` (body, array, required): Array of rows, where each row is an array of values (strings or numbers).

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/placeholder' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{
    "data": {
        "action": "update",
        "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
        "contractKey": "CONTRACT_KEY",
        "placeholder": {
            "placeholderKey": "PLACEHOLDER_KEY",
            "table": {
                "columns": ["Product", "Quantity", "Unit Price", "Total"],
                "rows": [
                    ["Product 1", 2, 100, 200],
                    ["Product 2", 1, 250, 250],
                    ["Product 3", 4, 75, 333]
                ]
            }
        }
    }
}'
```

Response:
```json
{
    "placeholder": {
        "id": "1",
        "createTime": "2025-10-31T09:27:46.000Z",
        "changeTime": "2025-10-31T09:28:23.000Z",
        "name": "PLACEHOLDER_NAME",
        "value": "{\"columns\":[\"Product\",\"Quantity\",\"Unit Price\",\"Total\"],\"rows\":[[\"Product 1\",2,100,200],[\"Product 2\",1,250,250],[\"Product 3\",4,75,333]]}",
        "isTable": true,
        "type": "1",
        "placeholderKey": "PLACEHOLDER_KEY",
        "position": "1",
        "fillingType": "1",
        "externalRecipientKey": null
    },
    "code": 201,
    "message": "Placeholder updated"
}
```

### Place basic placeholder

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/placeholder/pdfbasic

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/placeholder`

Basic placeholders are text placeholders that can be used to fill in HTML and PDF contracts. 
Additionally, they can be linked to any recipient afterward.

Before placing placeholders in a PDF, you need to [create them](https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/placeholder/create) in advance.

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `contractKey` (body, string, required): Key of the contract.
- `placeholders` (body, array, required): Array of placeholders.
  - `placeholderKey` (body, string, required): Key of the placeholder that needs to be updated.
  - `insertion` (body, array): Array of places.
    - `id` (body, string): ID of the insertion. Provide a new ID for each insertion. If you provide the ID of an existing placeholder, the placeholder will be updated.
    - `pageId` (body, string): Page number where you insert the placeholder, starting from 0.
    - `width` (body, string): Width of the placeholder.
    - `height` (body, string): Height of the placeholder.
    - `positionX` (body, string): Position X of the placeholder, starting from the top-left corner of the page.
    - `positionY` (body, string): Position Y of the placeholder, starting from the top-left corner of the page.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/placeholder' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{
    "data": {
        "action": "update",
        "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
        "contractKey": "CONTRACT_KEY",
        "placeholders": [
            {
                "placeholderKey": "PLACEHOLDER_KEY",
                "insertion": [
                    {
                        "action": "update",
                        "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
                        "id": 0,
                        "pageId": 0,
                        "width": 100,
                        "height": 100,
                        "positionX": 1,
                        "positionY": 1
                    }
                ]
            }
        ]
    }
}'
```

Response:
```json
{
    "code": 201,
    "message": "Placeholder updated"
}
```

### Place special placeholder

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/placeholder/pdfspecial

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/placeholder`

Special placeholders are four types of placeholders that are created automatically for every recipient.
So, before placing special fields in your PDF contract, create a recipient using [this request](https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/recipient/create).
After this, all the special placeholders will be created automatically with corresponding keys:
`Recipient_Key_1`, `Recipient_Key_2`, `Recipient_Key_3`, `Recipient_Key_4`.

Here's an example of a placeholder key: `"placeholderKey": "93447fb5-91ee-41ad-9f73-b4ae2d467292_4"`.

Available placeholder codes:
- <b>1</b>: Recipient's date signed.
- <b>2</b>: Recipient's full name.
- <b>3</b>: Recipient's email.
- <b>4</b>: Recipient's signature.

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `contractKey` (body, string, required): Key of the contract.
- `placeholders` (body, array, required): Array of placeholders.
  - `placeholderKey` (body, string, required): Key of the placeholder that needs to be updated. Generated automatically from 2 paramaters: Recipient's Key and Special Type.
  - `isSpecial` (body, boolean, required): True for special fields.
  - `specialType` (body, string, required): Use the following placeholder codes to create the corresponding fields: <b>1</b>: Recipient's date signed, <b>2</b>: Recipient's full name <b>3</b>: Recipient's email <b>4</b>: Recipient's signature
  - `insertion` (body, array): Array of places.
    - `id` (body, string): ID of the insertion. Provide a new ID for each insertion. If you provide the ID of an existing placeholder, the placeholder will be updated.
    - `pageId` (body, string): Page number where you insert the placeholder, starting from 0.
    - `width` (body, string): Width of the placeholder.
    - `height` (body, string): Height of the placeholder.
    - `positionX` (body, string): Position X of the placeholder, starting from the top-left corner of the page.
    - `positionY` (body, string): Position Y of the placeholder, starting from the top-left corner of the page.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/placeholder' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{
    "data": {
        "action": "update",
        "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
        "contractKey": "CONTRACT_KEY",
        "placeholders": [
            {
                "placeholderKey": "RECIPIENT_KEY_4",
                "isSpecial": true,
                "specialType": 4,
                "insertion": [
                    {
                        "action": "update",
                        "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
                        "id": 2,
                        "pageId": 0,
                        "width": 150,
                        "height": 150,
                        "positionX": 1,
                        "positionY": 1
                    }
                ]
            }
        ]
    }
}'
```

Response:
```json
{
    "code": 201,
    "message": "Placeholder updated"
}
```

### List of placeholders

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/placeholder/list

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/placeholder`

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `templateKey` (body, string): ID of the template. Use this parameter if you need to retrieve a template's placeholders.
- `contractKey` (body, string): Key of the contract. Use this parameter if you need to retrieve a contract's placeholders.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/placeholder' \ 
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{ 
          "data": {
              "action": "list",
              "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
              "contractKey": "CONTRACT_KEY",
              "templateKey": "TEMPLATE_KEY"
				  }
     }'
```

Response:
```json
{
    "placeholders": [
        {
            "id": "1",
            "createTime": "2024-02-26T11:07:55.000Z",
            "changeTime": "2024-02-26T11:07:59.000Z",
            "name": "Placeholder Name",
            "value": "Placeholder Value",
            "placeholderKey": "PLACEHOLDER_KEY",
            "position": 1,
            "fillingType": "4",
            "externalRecipientKey": "RECIPIENT_KEY"
        }
    ],
    "code": "200",
    "message": "Placeholders found"
}
```

### Delete placeholder

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/placeholder/delete

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/placeholder`

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `contractKey` (body, string, required): Key of the contract.
- `placeholder` (body, object, required): Structure.
  - `placeholderKey` (body, string, required): Key of the placeholder that needs to be deleted.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/placeholder' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{

        "action": "delete",

        "contractKey": "CONTRACT_KEY",

        }
    }
}'
```

Response:
```json
{
    "code": "200",
    "message": "Placeholder deleted"
}
```

## Recipient

### Create recipient

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/recipient/create

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/recipient`

One way to add recipients to a contract is when you send a contract. 
[See this page](https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/recipient/send) to learn more.

If you need to add a recipient to a contract without sending it, use the request below.

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `userKey` (body, string): ID of the user who is sending the contract. If not specified, the default user credentials will be used.
- `contractKey` (body, string, required): Key of the contract.
- `recipients` (body, array): Array of recipients, optional.
  - `action` (body, string): What the recipient needs to do with the contract. Available options: `view`, `sign`, `approve`, and `lock`.
  - `customMessage` (body, string): Custom note to the recipient. If not specified, the default message will be sent.
  - `fullname` (body, string): Full name of the recipient.
  - `email` (body, string, required): Email of the recipient.
  - `position` (body, number): Signing order. If not specified, all requests will be sent simultaneously.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/recipient' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{ 
		  "data": {
				   "action": "create",
				   "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
				   "contractKey": "CONTRACT_KEY",
           "recipients":[{
                "action": "view",
                "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
                "customMessage": "Custom message text",
                "fullname": "John Johnson", 
                "email": "john_johnson@mail.com", 
                "position": 1
               }], 
				  }
       }'
```

Response:
```json
{
       "result": true,
       "code": "200",
       "message": "Recipient created"
    }
```

### Update recipient

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/recipient/update

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/recipient`

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `contractKey` (body, string, required): Key of the contract.
- `recipient` (body, object, required): Structure, add the fields that need to be updated and ignore the rest.
  - `recipientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the recipient that needs to be updated.
  - `action` (body, string): What the recipient needs to do with the contract. Available options: `view`, `sign`, `approve`, and `lock`.
  - `customMessage` (body, string): Custom note to the recipient. If not specified, the default message will be sent.
  - `fullname` (body, string): Full name of the recipient.
  - `email` (body, string): Email of the recipient.
  - `position` (body, number): Signing order. If not specified, all requests will be sent simultaneously.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/recipient' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{
    "data": {
        "action": "update",
        "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
        "contractKey": "CONTRACT_KEY",
        "recipient": {
            "recipientKey": "RECIPIENT_KEY",
            "action": "view",
            "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
            "customMessage": "Custom message text",
            "fullname": "Full Name",
            "email": "email@email.com",
            "position": 1
        }
    }
}'
```

Response:
```json
{
       "recipient": {
                "changeTime": "2023-12-01 12:18:55"
		},
       "code": "201",
       "message": "Recipient updated"
    }
```

### Send to recipients

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/recipient/send

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/recipient`

One way to send a contract to recipients is when you create a contract. 
[See this page](https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/contract/create-send) to learn more.

If you need to send an existing contract to recipients, use the request below.

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `userKey` (body, string): ID of the user who is sending the contract. If not specified, the default user credentials will be used.
- `contractKey` (body, string, required): Key of the contract.
- `recipients` (body, array): Array of recipients, optional. If no array of recipients is provided, the system will send the contract to those recipients who were added previously.
  - `recipientKey` (body, string): A recipient key corresponds to an existing recipient in the contract you are sending. Use this parameter if you need to update any parameter of this specific recipient.
  - `action` (body, string): What the recipient needs to do with the contract. Available options: `view`, `sign`, `approve`, and `lock`.
  - `customMessage` (body, string): Custom note to the recipient. If not specified, the default message will be sent.
  - `fullname` (body, string): Full name of the recipient.
  - `email` (body, string, required): Email of the recipient.
  - `position` (body, number): Signing order. If not specified, all requests will be sent simultaneously.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/recipient' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{ 
		  "data": {
				   "action": "send",
				   "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
                   "userKey": "USER_KEY", 
				   "contractKey": "CONTRACT_KEY",
           "recipients":[
            {
                "recipientKey": "RECIPIENT_KEY",
                "action": "sign",
                "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
                "customMessage": "Custom message text",
                "fullname": "John Johnson", 
                "email": "john_johnson1@mail.com", 
                "position": 1
            },
            {
                "action": "view",
                "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
                "customMessage": "Custom message text",
                "fullname": "John Johnson", 
                "email": "john_johnson2@mail.com", 
                "position": 2
            }
               ], 
				  }
       }'
```

Response:
```json
{
       "result": true,
       "code": "200",
       "message": "Contract sent"
    }
```

### List of recipients

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/recipient/list

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/recipient`

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `contractKey` (body, string): Key of the contract. Use this parameter if you need to retrieve a contract's recipients.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/recipient' \ 
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{ 
          "data": {
              "action": "list",
              "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
              "contractKey": "CONTRACT_KEY"				  }
     }'
```

Response:
```json
{
    "recipients": [
        {
            "id": "1",
            "createTime": "2024-02-26T11:07:55.000Z",
            "changeTime": "2024-02-26T11:07:59.000Z",
            "name": "Recipient Name",
            "email": "Recipient Email",
            "customMessage": "Custom message text",
            "position": "1",
            "action": "view",
            "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
            "recipientKey": "RECIPIENT_KEY",
        }
    ],
    "code": "200",
    "message": "Recipients found"
}
```

### Delete recipient

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/recipient/delete

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/recipient`

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `contractKey` (body, string, required): Key of the contract.
- `recipient` (body, object, required): Structure.
  - `recipientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the recipient that needs to be deleted.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/recipient' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{
    "data": {
        "action": "delete",
        "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
        "contractKey": "CONTRACT_KEY",
        "recipient": {
            "recipientKey": "RECIPIENT_KEY"
        }
    }
}'
```

Response:
```json
{
    "result": true,
    "code": "200",
    "message": "Recipient deleted"
}
```

## Template

### Create template

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/template/create

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/template`

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `userKey` (body, string): ID of the user who create the template. If not specified, the default user credentials will be used.
- `template` (body, object, required): Template structure.
  - `name` (body, string): Name of the template.
  - `value` (body, string): Content of the template, use HTML.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/template' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{ 
		  "data": {
				   "action": "create",
				   "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
                   "userKey": "USER_KEY", 
				   "template": {
							  "name": "New template",
							  "value": "<p>Template text</p>"
						     }
				  }
       }'
```

Response:
```json
{
       "template": {
                "createTime": "2023-12-01 12:18:55",
                "templateKey": "TEMPLATE_KEY"
                 },
       "code": "201",
       "message": "Template created"
    }
```

### Create and fill in template

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/template/create-fill

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/template`

Using this way, you can create a template and define all placeholders 
with their names and values in a single API call.

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `userKey` (body, string): ID of the user who create the template. If not specified, the default user credentials will be used.
- `template` (body, object, required): Template structure.
  - `name` (body, string): Name of the template.
  - `value` (body, string): Content of the template, use HTML.
- `placeholders` (body, array): Array of placeholders, optional.
  - `name` (body, string): Name of the placeholder.
  - `value` (body, string): Value of the placeholder.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/template' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{
    "data": {
        "action": "create",
        "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
        "userKey": "USER_KEY",
        "template": {
            "name": "New template",
            "value": "<p>Template text</p>"
        },
        "placeholders": [
            {
                "name": "Company Name",
                "value": "Acme Inc."
            },
            {
                "name": "Contract Date",
                "value": "2024-01-15"
            }
        ]
    }
}'
```

Response:
```json
{
       "template": {
                "createTime": "2023-12-01 12:18:55",
                "templateKey": "TEMPLATE_KEY"
                 },
       "code": "201",
       "message": "Template created"
    }
```

### Update template

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/template/update

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/template`

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `template` (body, object, required): Structure, use the fields that should be updated.
  - `templateKey` (body, string, required): ID of the template.
  - `name` (body, string): Name of the template.
  - `value` (body, string): Content of the template, use HTML.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/template' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{ 
		  "data": {
				   "action": "update",
				   "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
				   "template": {
							  "templateKey": "TEMPLATE_KEY", 
							  "name": "New template",
							  "value": "<p>Template text</p>"
						     }
				  }
       }'
```

Response:
```json
{
       "template": {
                "createTime": "2023-12-01 12:18:55",
                "changeTime": "2023-12-01 12:18:55",
                "templateKey": "TEMPLATE_KEY", 
		},
       "code": "201",
       "message": "Template updated"
    }
```

### Convert into template

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/template/convert

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/template`

When converting a contract into a template, all content will be transferred to the template, 
and all placeholders will be transferred with their values removed. The original contract will remain unchanged.

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `userKey` (body, string): ID of the user who converts a contract into a template. If not specified, the default user credentials will be used.
- `template` (body, object, required): Template structure.
  - `name` (body, string, required): Name of the new template.
  - `contractKey` (body, string, required): Key of the contract that will be converted into a template.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/template' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{ 
		  "data": {
				   "action": "convert",
				   "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
                   "userKey": "USER_KEY", 
				   "template": {
							  "name": "New template",
							  "contractKey": "CONTRACT_KEY"
						     }
				  }
       }'
```

Response:
```json
{
       "template": {
                "createTime": "2023-12-01 12:18:55",
                "templateKey": "TEMPLATE_KEY"
                 },
       "code": "201",
       "message": "Template created"
    }
```

### Read template

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/template/read

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/template`

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `template` (body, object, required): Structure, at least one of the fields must be filled.
  - `templateKey` (body, string): ID of the template.
  - `name` (body, string): Name of the template.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/template' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{ 
		  "data": {
				   "action": "read",
				   "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
				   "template": {
							  "templateKey": "TEMPLATE_KEY", 
							  "name": "New template"
						     }
				  }
       }'
```

Response:
```json
{
       "template": {
                "createTime": "2023-12-01 12:18:55",
				"changeTime": "2023-12-01 12:18:55",
                "templateKey": "TEMPLATE_KEY", 
				"name": "New template",
				"value": "<p>Template text</p>"
		},
       "code": "200",
       "message": "Template found"
    }
```

### Duplicate template

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/template/duplicate

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/template`

When duplicating a template, the placeholder structure is copied, but all placeholder values are cleared.

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `template` (body, object, required): Structure.
  - `templateKey` (body, string, required): Key of the template that needs to be duplicated.

```bash

     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{
    "data": {
        "action": "duplicate",
        "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
        "template": {
            "templateKey": "YOUR_TEMPLATE_KEY"
        }
    }
}'
```

Response:
```json
{
    "template": {
        "createTime": "2023-12-01 12:18:55",
        "templateKey": "NEW_TEMPLATE_KEY"
    },
    "code": "201",
    "message": "Template duplicated"
}
```

## Webhook

### Webhooks concept

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/webhook/concept

Webhooks can be created via API calls by using the API references from this section. 
Please bear in mind that webhooks are separated by Client Keys, so if you create multiple Client Keys for your platform, 
be sure to follow this rule.

When you listen for the webhooks, you will receive them with the `Content-Type: application/vnd.api+json` header.

Webhooks have 6 events to listen for your purposes:
- `Contract.created`: fires when a contract is created. 
- `Contract.sent`: fires for every recipient to whom a contract was sent.
- `Contract.seen`: fires every time a recipient opens a contract. 
- `Contract.approved`: fires every time a recipient approves a contract. 
- `Contract.signed`: fires every time a recipient signs a contract. 
- `Contract.fully_signed`: fires once when all the recipients have signed a contract. 

Below you will find the examples of webhooks.

### Create webhook

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/webhook/create

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/webhook`

Webhooks are created for the specific client key you use when creating a webhook.

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `webhooks` (body, array, required): Array of webhooks.
  - `url` (body, string, required): Webhook's endpoint.
  - `created` (body, boolean): Event to listen: `contract.created`.
  - `seen` (body, boolean): Event to listen: `contract.seen`.
  - `sent` (body, boolean): Event to listen: `contract.sent`.
  - `approved` (body, boolean): Event to listen: `contract.approved`.
  - `signed` (body, boolean): Event to listen: `contract.signed`.
  - `fullySigned` (body, boolean): Event to listen: `contract.fully_signed`.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/webhook' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{
    "data": {
        "action": "create",
        "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
        "webhooks": [
            {
                "url": "URL",
                "created": true,
                "seen": true,
                "sent": false,
                "approved": false,
                "signed": false,
                "fullySigned": true
            }
        ]
    }
}'
```

Response:
```json
{
    "webhooks": [
        {
            "createTime": "2024-04-08T08:58:54.000Z",
            "url": "testurl1",
            "secret": "whsec_123",
            "webhookKey": "WEBHOOK_KEY"
        }
    ],
    "code": "201",
    "message": "Webhooks created"
}
```

### Update webhook

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/webhook/update

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/webhook`

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `webhooks` (body, array, required): Array of webhooks. Add the fields that need to be updated and ignore the rest.
  - `webhookKey` (body, string, required): Webhook's key.
  - `url` (body, string): Webhook's endpoint.
  - `created` (body, boolean): Event to listen: `contract.created`.
  - `seen` (body, boolean): Event to listen: `contract.seen`.
  - `sent` (body, boolean): Event to listen: `contract.sent`.
  - `approved` (body, boolean): Event to listen: `contract.approved`.
  - `signed` (body, boolean): Event to listen: `contract.signed`.
  - `fullySigned` (body, boolean): Event to listen: `contract.fully_signed`.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/webhook' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{
    "data": {
        "action": "update",
        "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
        "webhooks": [
            {
                "webhookKey": "WEBHOOK_KEY",
                "url": "URL",
                "created": true,
                "seen": true
            }
        ]
    }
}'
```

Response:
```json
{
    "webhooks": [
        {
            "webhookKey": "WEBHOOK_KEY",
            "changeTime": "2024-04-08T09:01:12.000Z"
        }
    ],
    "code": "201",
    "message": "Webhooks updated"
}
```

### Read webhook

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/webhook/read

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/webhook`

Parameters:
- `action` (body, string, required): Action type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `webhooks` (body, array, required): Array of webhooks.
  - `webhookKey` (body, string, required): Webhook's key.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/webhook' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{
    "data": {
        "action": "read",
        "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
        "webhooks": [
            {
                "webhookKey": "WEBHOOK_KEY"
            }
        ]
    }
}'
```

Response:
```json
{
    "webhooks": [
        {
            "createTime": "2024-04-08T08:58:54.000Z",
            "changeTime": "2024-04-08T09:01:12.000Z",
            "url": "URL",
            "secret": "whsec_123",
            "webhookKey": "WEBHOOK_KEY",
            "created": true,
            "seen": true,
            "sent": false,
            "approved": false,
            "signed": false,
            "fullySigned": false
        }
    ],
    "code": "201",
    "message": "Webhooks read"
}
```

## Settings

### Email notifications

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/settings/email_notifications

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/settings`

Email notifications are updated for the specific client key you use when updating the settings.

By default, Sendforsign sends email notifications for various types of events: signing and approval 
requests, contract signed, and contract approved. You can disable these notifications if you prefer to use 
your own email vendor. To disable notifications for `contract.approved` and `contract.signed`, 
use the request provided below.

Parameters:
- `type` (body, string, required): Settings type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `notification` (body, object, required): Structure.
  - `approved` (body, boolean): Settings to change: send email notifications on `contract.approved`.
  - `signed` (body, boolean): Settings to change: send email notifications on `contract.signed`.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/settings' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{
    "data": {
        "type": "email_notifications",
        "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
        "notification": 
            {
                "approved": false,
                "signed": false
            }
    }
}'
```

Response:
```json
{
    "code": "201",
    "message": "Settings updated"
}
```

### Custom branding

Source: https://sendforsign.com/docs/api-reference/settings/branding

Endpoint: `POST https://api.sendforsign.com/api/settings`

You can customize the appearance of the emails you send via Sendforsign's infrastructure, use your own email domain, 
change the domain of recipient links you generate, and more.

Parameters:
- `type` (body, string, required): Settings type.
- `clientKey` (body, string, required): Key of the client.
- `branding` (body, object, required): Structure.
  - `emailFrom` (body, string): The sender's name that will be shown in the emails you send to recipients.
  - `emailDomain` (body, string): Available for Business accounts only. You'll need input from the Sendforsign team—contact your account manager.
  - `recipientLinkDomain` (body, string): Available for Business accounts only. You'll need input from the Sendforsign team—contact your account manager.
  - `emailExplainer` (body, string): A short text shown at the bottom of the emails you send to recipients.
  - `emailLogo` (body, string): The logo that will be shown in the emails you send to recipients. Provide a public URL to a PNG, JPG, JPEG, or SVG image (W154 x H30).
  - `emailButtonColor` (body, string): The button color that will be shown in the emails you send to recipients. Provide a hex code; the default is #1677ff.
  - `recipientPageBranding` (body, boolean): Available for Business accounts only. You'll need input from the Sendforsign team—contact your account manager.

Example:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.sendforsign.com/api/settings' \
     -H 'X-Sendforsign-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
     -d '{
    "data": {
        "type": "brandings",
        "clientKey": "YOUR_CLIENT_KEY",
        "branding": {
            "emailFrom": "",
            "emailDomain": "",
            "recipientLinkDomain": "",
            "emailExplainer": "",
            "emailLogo": "",
            "emailButtonColor": "",
            "recipientPageBranding": true
        }
    }
}'
```

Response:
```json
{
    "code": "201",
    "message": "Settings updated"
}
```
